Oil Companies Face Significant Daily Losses Amid Crude Price Surge

Oil marketing companies (OMCs) are incurring daily losses of Rs 530 crore due to the surge in crude oil prices. Losses per liter of petrol and diesel are reportedly as high as ₹9. Rising crude oil prices have been cited as the primary reason for these financial setbacks.
